title: destination-repo-set
description: The config datum naming the repos summaries are filed into (fetched and pulled before summarizing, goal.md clause 13). A repo is named and remote-addressed only; where it is checked out locally is deployment config, never seam data.

config-key.description: a key under .rbtv/config/modules/office/meeting-summarizer/ — a name resolved through config, never a filesystem path

repo-name.description: short name of one destination repo, unique within the set

remote.description: git remote reference (URL or configured remote name); never a local path

repo-file-ref.description: one file inside one destination repo
